detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The AquaDream Soundtracks pack features the 5 original tracks from the game, composed by Joshua Liljeblad, along with their Reverb versions:

  • Deep Ocean

  • River Reef Shark

  • The Hidden Temple

  • Sunny Shores

  • The Choral Reef

Along with their Reverb versions.
